concept.title: Grayscale Palettes
concept.shortdesc: A grayscale palette is a range of shades from black to white without any color hue.

conbody.p: A grayscale palette contains only black to white, featuring only variations in gray without any color hue. The gray has multiple levels to reflect differences in shade, depth, and shadows.

fig.title: Image in color vs Image in grayscale

section.title: How are Grayscale Palettes Used?
section.p: Grayscale palettes are often used in design, photography, and art to emphasize contrast, tone, and composition without the distraction of color.
